The selected pages of this section cover the driver's role among the three elements of driving, emotional fitness to drive, medical factors, the relationship between driver age and crashes, and the problems of younger and older drivers; they discuss driver attitude, emotions, medical condition and age, and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the behavioral guidance is stable, and the age-band crash statistics are printed without a survey year in this twenty twenty-three edition, with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.
